title: Fixed timeline semaphore signaling issue in BLAS builds
implementation_summary: Fixed critical bug where multiple BLAS builds tried to signal same timeline value
Moved command buffer creation outside loop to batch all BLAS builds
Single timeline signal after all BLAS commands recorded

bug_analysis.issue: Timeline semaphore signal value must always increment
bug_analysis.root_cause: Loop was signaling same value multiple times
bug_analysis.solution: Batch all BLAS builds in single command buffer submission

validation_errors_fixed: VUID-VkSubmitInfo2-semaphore-03882: Signal value must be greater than pending value
testing_guidance: Enter mesh mode to trigger shell extraction
Verify no validation errors about timeline semaphore values
Check that shell BLAS builds complete successfully
Confirm TLAS can wait on BLAS completion
acceptance_criteria_status: ✅ All BLAS builds complete in single submission
